units.text: The files to compare are ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, and ⟦2⟧. At most one of these three file names may be ⟦3⟧, which tells ⟦4⟧ to read the standard input for that file.
units.sourceHTML: The files to compare are mine, older, and yours. At most one of these three file names may be -, which tells diff3 to read the standard input for that file.

units.text: An exit status of 0 means ⟦0⟧ was successful, 1 means some conflicts were found, and 2 means trouble.
